name: Industronics Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公布任何业务扩张、新业务或合约公告，主要事件为2026年5月5日被列入PN17（财务困境）并发布首份PN17公告，随后每月发布PN17进展公告；同期出现重大诉讼公告，2026年6月30日止季度营收同比大幅下降90.7%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any business expansion, new business, or contract wins. The main events were its admission into PN17 (financial distress) on 5 May 2026 with the first PN17 announcement, followed by monthly PN17 updates; material litigation announcements were also made, and revenue for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 fell 90.7% year-on-year.
